pick.headline: Soviet fighters force down Korean Air Lines Flight 902 near Murmansk
pick.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of April 21, 1978, carried Moscow TASS on an 'unidentified plane' violating Soviet airspace near Murmansk and landing on a lake near Kem, plus Seoul radio citing Kosygin that two people died in the landing.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Soviet Union, Vol. III No. 78, 21 April 1978
evidence.snippet: …n the vicinity of the town of Kem in the Karelian Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republic only two hours after entering the USSR's air space, After the plane's landing it was established that this Boeing-707 belongs to the South Korean air company. Competent Soviet authorities are investigating the causes of this violation of the Soviet Union's airspace. The passengers and crew of the plane were taken to the neares* populated locality and arrangements…
